factor_1_basis: Indeterminable, and routed unverifiable rather than resolved by convenience. The notice arrived appended to a BASH tool result. Bash returns FREE TEXT, so there is no structural boundary between the tool payload and text appended after it, and body-vs-adjacent cannot be established. An attribution argument exists in principle — the checkout was mine — but #680 is open on whether a constrained free-text command output licenses that argument. Note the contrast with the three benign captures at 20260907T224130Z, which followed an MCP tool returning STRUCTURED JSON where the boundary IS legible: same harness message, different channel, honestly different verdict.
